findings.summary: The zero-context diff hashed by patch-id ignores hunk locations, so applying the same replacement to a different occurrence in the same file can retain the identity and let review-evidence accept a review of different code.

disposition.reason: Accepted known limitation, not a new defect: spec §5.3 and plan Task 10 record that the identity has no location, so moving an edit onto another identical line keeps it (accepted by David 2026-11-02, PR #52). Adding line numbers would break D-10: a main change above the PR's lines would void its reviews.

findings.summary: A task range such as T9007199254740992-T9007199254740992 passes validation but loops forever because incrementing that Number no longer changes it, allowing a PR body to hang the evidence check until its timeout.
